title: Roll out pre-P03 result recovery and verify external settlement on the operating database

source.execution_instruction: Owner answer 'Approve full rollout' in this session to the question approving eight listed operating steps at merge 6e4b85c, after the read-only preflight was reported

authorizes: a snapshot-consistent logical dump of the operating database and a restore check in an isolated cluster before any operating write
P02 preservation hashes and per-row hashes of the 21 protected tables before and after
running the API, web and worker from the PR #231 merge commit with MATCHFORGE_RESULT_RECOVERY_INTERVAL=0
one fixture, one UTC date and one bounded batch of at most 8 dates per provider, with at most 40 of the day's remaining API-Football requests
two Admin external prediction settlement runs to check idempotency
MATCHFORGE_RESULT_RECOVERY_INTERVAL=30m, observation of at least four scheduled cycles and a controlled restart test
recording this decision, the rollout evidence and the resulting status
requires: the handoff's stop conditions: unexplained protected-row differences, results without qualified evidence, incorrect or duplicate settlement, uncontrolled provider retries, invalid backup or recovery capability, or an API that cannot read sync history
no change to any published forecast, artifact, prediction selection or prior history decision
explicitly_not_authorized: running the migration's down operation or rolling the API or web back below the PR #231 merge
deleting databases, rewriting forecasts, bulk storage cleanup or new copies of operating data beyond the one dump and restore check
a global historical backfill, or forcing settlement of predictions without verified identity and qualified results
